A message in a locale with a fallback that equals the message it falls back to, so it can be removed.

The check is on by default, with the severity `warning`.



## Configure

Change the severity, or turn the check off, in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from '@x18n/core'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'redundant-translation': 'off',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only redundant-translation` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip redundant-translation` skips it for one run.
